title: The Wall
description: A full-bleed image wall, interrupted by an oversized orange identity band. Every project has its place.
signature: Screens resolve from dither into colour, bend with scroll and pointer velocity, then travel into a new arrangement when the wall is sorted.
holdback: The replacement desktop capture visibly establishes real Bayer dithering, confirmed by the shader, and the mobile capture now fills the frame with public project imagery. Visible colour/year/category controls give the wall a useful browsing purpose. This earns a modest increase over the provisional resolved-colour review, but the orange identity band still masks substantial work; on mobile it interrupts the first project pair. Material treatment and useful sorting do not yet make a distinctive information structure.
slopCauses: Oversized first-and-last-name identity dominates and obscures the work.
The Archivo display face is shared with most reviewed directions.
